evidence.detail: Only traces and metrics pipelines are configured; there is no logs pipeline.
Promtail B reads /var/log/pods and sends stdout records to Loki B.
Promtail A reads the same /var/log/pods files and sends stdout records to Loki A.
Conventional Pino logger; no OTel log bridge or context export.
Charge handler emits the observed application log through the conventional logger.
Sections 9, 10, and 14 define contextual B logs and explicit log-trace correlation as a permitted treatment difference.
The same Charge stdout record was present in both backends with no trace_id/span_id fields.

affected_invariant: Scenario B logs must carry trace/span context when an active context naturally exists; Scenario A must remain conventionally uncorrelated.
scientific_impact: The intended log contextualization/correlation treatment is absent; backend separation alone does not implement it. Stage 7 logging coverage is not proven.
why_automatic_correction_is_unsafe: Adding trace IDs to shared stdout would expose correlation in A; removing them later would alter RAW post-emission. A correct B-only route requires cross-language contextual logging integrations plus an OTLP Logs pipeline and careful duplicate handling.
recommended_correction: Add idiomatic per-language OTel logging integrations for B, export logs separately over OTLP to Collector B and Loki B, and leave conventional stdout collection for A unchanged.
alternative_correction: Explicitly revise the experiment design to remove or narrow B log correlation treatment; requires a methodological decision.
minimum_information_needed_for_decision: Approve separate B OTLP Logs path while preserving stdout A, or explicitly revise the B log-correlation treatment.
Define handling for services with no natural log in a normal workload.
Define how duplicate stdout and OTLP copies are prevented or classified.
working_tree: DIRTY: uncommitted Stage 7 implementation changes retained for review
